checks.text: With no entries the page shows the heading "Sleep Tracker", the text "No sleep entries yet", and the summary lines "Total nights: 0", "Average duration: 0h 00m", and "Streak: 0 days".

Filling the field labelled "Date" with "2024-01-15", the field labelled "Duration" with "7h 30m", choosing "Good" in the select labelled "Quality" and clicking the button "Log sleep" adds a list item that contains "2024-01-15", "7h 30m", and "Good"; the summary shows "Total nights: 1", "Average duration: 7h 30m", and "Streak: 1 days".

After also logging "2024-01-16" with Duration "6h 15m" and Quality "Fair", a list item contains "2024-01-16", "6h 15m", and "Fair", and the summary shows "Total nights: 2", "Average duration: 6h 53m", and "Streak: 2 days".
Clicking "Log sleep" with an empty Duration field adds no list item and shows the message "Enter a valid duration".

Every list item has a button named "Delete 2024-01-15". With entries for 2024-01-15 and 2024-01-16, clicking "Delete 2024-01-15" removes that item and the summary shows "Total nights: 1", "Average duration: 6h 15m", and "Streak: 1 days".
Typing "8h" in the field labelled "Duration" and clicking "Log sleep" adds a list item that contains "8h 00m".
After logging "2024-01-15" with Duration "7h 30m" and Quality "Good", the heatmap section shows a cell for "2024-01-15" with the text "7h 30m".
After logging "2024-01-15" with Duration "7h 30m" and Quality "Good", the trend chart section shows a data point labelled "2024-01-15" with the value "7.5".
Reload keeps the entry for "2024-01-15" with "7h 30m" and "Good" visible in the list, and the summary line "Total nights: 1".
